derivation: from a compound of the base of G4756 (στρατιά) and G3004 (λέγω) (in its original sense);
def: to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army

words.word: him who hath chosen him to be a soldier

occurrences.text: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
